title: Is It in the Array?
description:
Given an array `nums` and a number `target`, return `true` if `target` is somewhere in the array, otherwise `false`.

Example: for `nums = [4, 9, 1]` and `target = 9`, return `true`.
hints: Concept: `return` ends the method immediately, even in the middle of a loop. `boolean` means the answer is `true` or `false`.
Approach: check each number. The moment you find `target`, you know the answer is true, so return it straight away. If the loop finishes without finding it, the answer is false.

workedExample.title: Is There a Zero?
workedExample.description: Return `true` if any number in `nums` is 0.
workedExample.explanation:
This is the **search and stop early** pattern. You don't need to look at the rest of the array once you've found what you want.

The `return false` after the loop only runs if nothing matched.

walkthrough.note: Found 9! Return true right away. We never even look at 1.

mistakes.hint: You returned `false` as soon as the first number didn't match. You can only say "not found" after checking every number, so put `return false` after the loop.
